concept: A stake vault blocked by a single unsolicited token transfer, so unstaking fails
scene: Technical brand card on a deep navy background: a vault box connected to a stake account, with one small amber token dropping into the vault and a broken close-account link beside it. Clean engineering diagram style with simple lines and no extra text beyond the overlay.
alt_text: Diagram of a stake vault receiving one small unsolicited token, which stops the vault from closing and blocks unstaking.
